name: Glimpse of the Lost Path
description: Three days lost in the woods. She learned to ask the forest for directions. Not a map, just a feeling: a pull, a sense of which way leads home. It is not always right, but it is always hopeful.

params.message: Three days of walking, and every hour of them, comes back to you at once.
You catch a glimpse of a familiar landmark -- the village, the well, the tree with the low branch. You think you know which way to go.
params.fail_message: You reach for a sense of direction and find only trees, and more trees.
